info.title: Jeninnet.FileQuery.Tool
info.description: Terminal file discovery tool built on Jeninnet.FileQuery. Matches GitIgnore, Glob, and Regex patterns and streams results to standard output.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Queries files with GitIgnore, Glob, or Regex patterns and writes the matches to standard output.

Patterns default to Hybrid mode, where each pattern is classified automatically. Use --dialect
to force a single dialect. When no pattern is supplied every file is returned.

Examples:
  dotnet-filequery "**;!*.cs"
  dotnet-filequery --glob "**/*.md" --root ./docs
  dotnet-filequery --gitignore "**;!*.cs;!*.csproj" --depth 3
  dotnet-filequery --dialect regex "\.Tests\.cs$" --count
  dotnet-filequery --changed-since HEAD~5 --count
  dotnet-filequery "**;!*.log" --null | xargs -0 wc -l

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --patterns
options.description:
Patterns applied in order. Prefix regular expressions with 'r:'.
Separate multiple patterns with ';' (e.g. *.txt;!temp.txt).
Patterns cannot end with ".." or contain consecutive "..".

options.name: --gitignore
options.description: GitIgnore-style patterns applied in order ('!' re-includes a path).

options.name: --glob
options.description: Glob-style patterns applied in order.

options.name: --regex
options.description: Regular-expression patterns applied in order; the 'r:' prefix is optional.

options.name: --root
options.description: Root directory to search. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]

options.name: --dialect
options.description: Force one pattern dialect: hybrid (default), gitignore, glob, or regex. [default: hybrid]

options.name: --no-recursive
options.description: Search only the root directory; do not descend into subdirectories. [default: False]

options.name: --depth
options.description: Maximum recursion depth. 0 searches the root directory only.

options.name: --ignore-case
options.description: Match pattern characters without case sensitivity. [default: False]

options.name: --symlinks
options.description: Symbolic link policy: ignore (default), follow, or follow-with-cycle-detection. [default: ignore]

options.name: --relative
options.description: Write paths relative to the root directory instead of absolute paths. [default: False]

options.name: --null
options.description: Separate output paths with a NUL character (for xargs -0 and similar tools). [default: False]

options.name: --count
options.description: Write only the number of matching files. [default: False]

options.name: --changed-since
options.description: Limit the query to files changed since a commit, tag, or branch (includes untracked files).

options.name: --changed-since-date
options.description: Limit the query to files changed since an ISO 8601 timestamp (uses the last commit before it).

options.name: --no-untracked
options.description: Exclude untracked files when a --changed-since baseline is used. [default: False]

options.name: --explain
options.description: Write one line per file with its include/exclude outcome and reason instead of matching paths. [default: False]

options.name: --ignore-files
options.description: Load .gitignore files (root and nested), .git/info/exclude, and the optional --global-ignore file. [default: False]

options.name: --global-ignore
options.description: Additional global Git ignore file to load with --ignore-files. Relative paths are resolved against the root.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write one JSON object per line with path and metadata; combine with --explain for outcomes and reasons. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATTERNS
arguments.description:
Patterns to match. Each value may contain multiple patterns separated by ';'.
Defaults to every file when omitted.
